verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents background automation in the form of fixed agents: a Customer Screening and Ongoing Monitoring agent and a Transaction Monitoring agent that auto-remediate level 1 alerts and automatically escalate high-risk cases. Users can also turn on per-customer ongoing monitoring via the API. These are prebuilt workflows, not a general automation builder, and Starter Plan agent configurations cannot be customized. Missing for 10: a user-defined automation/trigger builder, scheduling or recurrence controls, documented setup and customization of the agents, and hands-on or independent corroboration of autonomous operation.
